about_the_game:
Get ready for an intense and adrenaline-pumping experience with this short-lived singleplayer game set in a maze that seems to have no end. With an average duration of up to 10 minutes, each session is designed to offer quick but memorable challenges.

You find yourself in a maze, not knowing how you got there. Your only goal: to find the exit before the enemies find you. Ruthless creatures that await you among the corridors and chase the player as soon as they detect your presence, requiring quick decisions and strategic movement.

The gameplay combines elements of action and survival, with a real-time perspective that puts the player in constant tension. As you explore the maze, you'll need to be agile, use the environment to your advantage, and watch out for dead-end entrances that can become fatal traps.

Key features:

  • Quick matches: Each game is up to 10 minutes long, ideal for short, intense sessions.

  • Dynamic maze: face a labyrinthine scenario that requires attention and strategy to escape.

  • Intelligent enemies: opponents who chase the player and react to their presence.

  • Immersive solo experience: 100% singleplayer, focused on tension and personal challenge.

Will you be able to escape, or will you be another lost soul in this vast labyrinth?
